baseline: Production-profile ordinary watcher reported one ACT_PUBLISHED send. After pruning the operational payload, the physical receipt survived but inspect_content returned None through two exact restores.
scope: Prospective single-part direct ACT_PUBLISHED first freeze. Reuses Bill and DeliveryPlan snapshots, exact existing rendered text, physical publication identity, and original formatter/language. Optional explicit evidence binds kind/channel/ref. No StatusChange synthesized.
format: Existing schema. Reader validates immutable snapshot parentage, exact binding, owner, single-message plan and matching live operational plan if retained. Former reader rejects the new profile atomically, so the compatible reader release must precede writer.

paired.other_delta: Only runs.report_json phase_seconds. All physical publication and operational rows exact.

retry_qualification: Remote pre-send snapshot includes the immutable version. Lost outcome restores as UNKNOWN with no current edition and no automatic send. Audited retry uses original frozen plan without re-render; audited confirm sends nothing. Both preserve the same immutable version and set it current once confirmed.

limits.formats: ru/en known formatter, original direct with existing reply target. Legacy attempts, digest-owned, revisions and multipart stay outside capture. Forced multipart checkpoint fixture verified physical delivery and absence of history. No backfill.
